message: P1 review a9476e62c3104c0f95fedf6e8e54ac51 = ChangesRequested, frozen ed4e2728. Existing opt-in recheck after final await is improved, but two independently reproduced authorization violations remain: (1) site/host permission revoked DURING final awaited window lookup still allows chrome.tabs.create because final host permission isn't rechecked; see findings/revoked-host-permission-after-window-lookup.md. (2) queued OpenTab crosses disable/re-enable because authorization epoch is captured when queue executes, not when request received; see findings/queued-opentab-survives-optin-revocation.md. Fix only these two edges: pin request-reception authorization/epoch and validate final opt-in + host/site permission + socket/epoch after last await before tabs.create. Add deterministic negative tests, .NET11 Release/Node, fresh frozen review. No deploy/restart.
